stem: Quincy would like to provide some additional support for the idea he has presented in sentence 19. Which of these ideas could best follow and support sentence 19?

options.label: F
options.text: Doctors say this misconception may come from a slight change in blood pressure and blood flow during a sneeze, which may briefly change heart rhythm.

options.label: G
options.text: This common myth, that a person’s heart stops during a sneeze, is just a myth, which means that there is no truth to the idea at all.

options.label: H
options.text: A myth is defined as a “widely held but false belief or idea,” and the concept of the heart not beating during a sneeze is just that, a myth.

options.label: J
options.text: Some people say that if you breathe through your mouth and pinch your nose when you feel a sneeze coming on, you can stop it.
